title: Determination of the Statutory Tax Due on a Hotel Rate Plans Stay
content:
This determination settles the statutory tax due on a Hotel Rate Plans stay.

## 1. The room money posted

The room money posted is the prepayment lines and the room lines standing on the reservation taken together. 0 percent of the occupant supplement posted is counted as room money.

## 2. The nights and the gross-up

The nights of the stay already covered on the folio are taken as the highest night sequence the folio's room lines carry.

The room money the tax acts on is the room money posted grossed up in the proportion the nights the reservation covers bear to the nights already covered on the folio.

## 3. The taxable room money and the rate

The taxable room money is the room money the tax acts on reduced by a discount of 0 percent.

The statutory rate is the occupancy tax rate the rate plan booked carries, and the statutory tax due is the taxable room money at that rate, levied once on the whole taxable room money rather than night by night.

Every figure is rounded to two decimal places as it is worked out, and the statutory tax due is rounded the same way.

## 4. Worked on hypothetical figures

Take a reservation covering 4 nights and holding 1 room, whose folio carries room lines of 900.00 USD and prepayment lines of 300.00 USD, an occupant supplement of 200.00 USD, and room lines reaching a highest night sequence of 3. The rate plan booked carries an occupancy tax rate of 12.5 percent.

1. The room money posted is 900.00 USD and 300.00 USD taken together, which is 1,200.00 USD; 0 percent of the 200.00 USD occupant supplement is counted, adding 0.00 USD.
2. The nights already covered on the folio are 3, being the highest night sequence the folio's room lines carry.
3. The room money the tax acts on is 1,200.00 USD grossed up in the proportion 4 nights bear to 3 nights, which is 1,600.00 USD.
4. The taxable room money is 1,600.00 USD reduced by a discount of 0 percent, which is 1,600.00 USD.
5. The statutory rate is 12.5 percent, and the statutory tax due is 12.5 percent of 1,600.00 USD levied once on the whole figure, which is **200.00 USD**.

Had the folio's room lines reached a highest night sequence of 4, the proportion would be 4 nights to 4 nights, the room money the tax acts on would stand at 1,200.00 USD, and the statutory tax due would be 150.00 USD.
